name: MU_AuthorizeNet_ParkingPayment_Webhook
description: Receives the Authorize.net payment webhook (publish this pipeline as a serverless API and register its URL as the webhook endpoint in Authorize.net, scoped to the net.authorize.payment.authcapture.created event). The webhook body is NOT trusted: the pipeline re-fetches the transaction from Authorize.net via getTransactionDetailsRequest, confirms it was approved and captured, then calls the Ellucian Workflow API trigger to start the 'issue parking permit' workflow. That workflow holds the native Create Task -> Public Safety action. The order invoiceNumber (student ID + term, set when the hosted-payment token was minted) is the correlation key Public Safety uses to look up the vehicle details from the original parking form submission.

parameters.name: authNetLoginId
parameters.label: Authorize.net API Login ID
parameters.description: Same API Login ID used by the token pipeline (Account > Security Settings > API Credentials).

parameters.name: authNetTransactionKey
parameters.label: Authorize.net Transaction Key
parameters.description: Same Transaction Key used by the token pipeline.

parameters.name: signatureKey
parameters.label: Authorize.net Signature Key
parameters.description: Optional. The Signature Key from Authorize.net used to validate the X-ANET-Signature header (HMAC-SHA512 of the raw body). Webhook signature verification is best-effort here; the authoritative control is the server-to-server getTransactionDetails re-fetch below.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.description: Must match the token pipeline. 'sandbox' targets apitest.authorize.net; 'production' targets api.authorize.net.

parameters.name: workflowTriggerUrl
parameters.label: Workflow API Trigger URL
parameters.description: The API-trigger endpoint URL of the 'issue parking permit' workflow, copied from the Ellucian Workflow designer. The pipeline POSTs the verified payment details to this URL to start the workflow.

parameters.name: workflowAuthHeaderName
parameters.label: Workflow Auth Header Name
parameters.description: Name of the HTTP header used to authenticate to the Workflow API trigger (e.g. 'Authorization' or 'apikey'). Leave default if the trigger uses a bearer token.

parameters.name: workflowApiKey
parameters.label: Workflow Auth Header Value
parameters.description: Value sent in the auth header above (e.g. 'Bearer <token>' or a raw API key). Omit only if the trigger is unauthenticated.
